verdict.rationale: There is explicit support for bulk import of config/env vars (maritime-docs-11) and a scriptable CLI/API with JSON output (maritime-docs-9, maritime-docs-36) that an AI-native user could loop over to perform bulk actions, but there is no documented batch/bulk endpoint for operating on many agents or resources at once. missing for 10: a dedicated bulk-operation API/CLI command (e.g. bulk create/delete/update agents), evidence of scaling to many items reliably, and independent confirmation of bulk workflows in practice.
